provenance.source: new: 2026-10-24 real-host bug. A plugin installed with `murmo plugin add` never ran on any host: Pi showed it `on` in `murmo plugin list` while a TODO send guard and a status counter did nothing, because every adapter loaded only its built-ins. `installed` is applied by the harness with `murmo plugin add` (and `disable`) before the host starts
provenance.author: murmo

cases.note: The installed plugin runs in the isolated helper with the grants the user reviewed and blocks a send that says zzhold, on every host: no request reaches the model and the draft stays.
After `murmo plugin disable send-hold`, a new session sends the same prompt. Beside installed-plugin-holds-send this proves the block came from the plugin, not from Murmo or the host.
